# [CS059] Dependency Without go.sum Checksum (gomod-missing-checksum)

A direct requirement has no content hash in go.sum.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | HIGH |
| **Category** | Supply Chain & Provenance |
| **CWE** | [CWE-353](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/353.html) |
| **OWASP** | A03:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

go.sum pins the exact content of each module version. Without it the content is not verified against what was reviewed, and builds depend on whatever the proxy or origin serves.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```text
// go.mod requires github.com/google/uuid v1.6.0, but go.sum has no line for it
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```text
// go mod tidy, then commit go.sum:
github.com/google/uuid v1.6.0 h1:NIvaJDMOsjHA8n1jAhLSgzrAzy1Hgr+hNrb57e+94F0=
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [gomod-missing-checksum]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    gomod-missing-checksum: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore gomod-missing-checksum -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** gomod-missing-checksum
```
